records.subject: Quantum-tunneling model of emphanisis
records.quote: Motivated by the celebrated vibration-inversion resonance of the ammonia molecule, we propose a quantum tunneling-based model for emphanisis where decoherence is responsible for the local symmetry breaking with increasing temperature.
modality_evidence: Motivated by the celebrated vibration-inversion resonance of the ammonia molecule, we propose a quantum tunneling-based model for emphanisis where decoherence is responsible for the local symmetry breaking with increasing temperature.

From the analytic expression of the temperature dependence of the tunnel splitting (which serves as an order parameter), we provide three-parameter fitting formulas that capture the observed temperature dependence of the ionic displacements as well as the anomalous increase in the excitonic bandgap in all the relevant materials.
records.conditions: Proposed quantum-tunneling model for emphanisis in lead- and tin-containing chalcogenides and halide perovskites
